import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")
# Check for git repo in the project
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("ls -la /opt/areloria/.git 2>/dev/null && cd /opt/areloria && git status --short | head -20")
print("Git:", stdout.read().decode())
client.close()
EOF
